headline: Synopsys (SNPS) Stock May Be 24% Below Fair Value On AI Design Tool News
summary: Synopsys stock has had a tough year, with a sharp share price decline sitting alongside a split valuation picture where the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) estimate points to meaningful upside while market multiples suggest the stock is expensive.
